A direct controller must own strictly more than 50% of voting shares. Control follows successive qualifying links; do not multiply percentages. Exactly 50% does not qualify. The ultimate controller is the last entity reached; if there is no qualifying owner, return the starting company itself. All unlisted shares are dispersed, with no controlling individual.
Kite owns 90% of Juniper.
North owns 90% of Birch.
Tide owns 50% of Kite.
Elm owns 90% of Drift.
Juniper owns 60% of Iris.
Birch owns 75% of Tide.
